d: Three Wellington College schoolboys wanted to watch India take on New Zealand in Test cricket at the Basin Reserve. A moment of excitement, a camera on the big screen and three boys trying to hide their faces turned into an unexpected talking point after New Zealand Deputy Prime Minister David Seymour criticised their decision to miss school. His comments about rubbish collection then sparked a debate about respect for every profession. Rupha Ramani looks at why this little cricket story became much bigger than three boys watching a Test match.
